messages:
lee: Morning handoff from twilight shift — quick summary of what happened and current state. Yesterday ~02:10 UTC we started seeing a spike in 503s from the embeddings path (region: eu-west). Incident bot paged at 02:13 :rotating_light:. Auto-scaling didn't catch up due to a cold-start/instance provisioning lag in the dedicated pool. We did an emergency routing fallback to embeddings-v2-quant which increased latency but reduced error rate. Current status: errors down to ~0.5% (was 8%), latency p95 is ~420ms (baseline ~180ms). No customer-facing degraded alerts active now.

lee: Primary/secondary for my shift — i'm primary, @maria is secondary for EU/US overlap. @khalid will be on-call for DB/infra escalation. @aj will handle customer comms if we need to open a postmortem. (Please ack)

maria: ack. i'll shadow metrics and routing for the first hour. looking at autoscaler logs now.

sre-bot: Incident opened: INC-2026-8453 | embeddings 503 surge | Severity: S2 | pageres: multiple customers > 5% error during peak. Links: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-8453

lee: tl;dr timeline: 02:10 spike -> 02:13 pager -> 02:18 tried scale-up (rejected, quota hit) -> 02:22 initiated fallback routing -> 02:25 error rate dropped. 02:30 started a short cache warm-up job to prefill prefix keys for high-qps customers. We also temporarily increased per-customer concurrency cap for dedicated customers to avoid global queue pile-up.

khalid: looked at provisioning logs: provisioning requests were queued due to a stray quota enforcement from a recent quota change on the dedicated pool. I removed the restrictive quota rule at 02:20 which allowed fallback instances to come up faster. I left a note in eng-infra-runbook. Will file a config-change PR to prevent the rule from blocking autoscaler in the future.

maria: observability notes: key dashboards — embeddings/service_errors, embeddings/latency_p95, autoscaler/queue_length. I added a temp panel to correlate slow starts with quota messages. If you want to reproduce: run the repro script in staging: `./scripts/repro/embed-503.sh --qps 1200 --region eu-west` (beware it will create load)

lee: customer impact: we saw some elevated 4xx/5xx telemetry for three midsize customers for ~12 minutes during the spike. No long-term data loss. CS notified customers with a brief note; @aj please confirm any follow-ups.

aj: I sent the initial customer note at 03:05 UTC to the affected accounts. Draft for post-incident follow-up is in docs: https://redwood.internal/ops/customer-comm/embeddings-0826-draft.md — tagging for review. Will hold off on broad comms until we have root cause and remediation timeline.

maria: runbook pointers: primary runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-503 (steps 1-7 for immediate mitigation). Key commands copied below:

maria: ```
# scale fallback pool
redwoodctl scale pool dedicated-eu-west --replicas 4

# enable routing override
redwoodctl routing set --service embeddings --fallback embeddings-v2-quant --duration 30m

# check autoscaler queue
redwoodctl autoscaler status --pool dedicated-eu-west
```

lee: current open action items:
- (lee) follow up with infra to revert the quota change and submit PR (blocking config) — in progress
- (khalid) add guardrails to the autoscaler so quota rules don't block scale-up (PR + test) — assigned
- (maria) run a controlled load test in staging to validate warm-up + routing fallback behavior — scheduled 08:30 UTC
- (aj) finalize customer follow-up and coordinate CS sync — pending review
- (lee) keep routing fallback for another 20m then re-evaluate; if stable we rollback fallback and let autoscaler handle scale gradually

khalid: note — there's a known edge-case in the provisioning path where `instance-provisioner` retries with exponential backoff up to 12m. If provisioning keeps failing after edits, escalate to oncall-private infra and consider manual instance insertion (docs in eng-infra -> provisioning manual insert).

sre-bot: Deploy bot: `deploy/service-embeddings@v2.3.8` promoted to canary at 04:10 UTC (no failures reported). (this was unrelated but worth noting for timeline)

lee: coverage gap: after rollback we'll have reduced spare capacity in eu-west for ~10-15m while new instances spin up. Suggest setting a temporary soft cap on non-critical batch jobs that hit the embeddings pool: tag `embeddings:throttle=soft` on cron jobs for next 30m. Ops-bot can apply if approved.

ops-bot: automode: applying soft throttle tag to cron jobs with label `job-type=batch` in eu-west for 30m — will report back when done.

maria: thanks — confirmed cron throttles applied. Also leaving a sticky note in runbook about checking quota policy after any infra config changes.

lee: additional context for the next shift: monitor both fallback route error rate and autoscaler queue length. If fallback keeps >0.5% errors for 30m, escalate to SRE lead. If queue length > 50 for >10m, consider manual scale or temporary routing to global pool.

khalid: i'll open a follow-up ticket tracking the PR + test matrix, linking to the incident and runbook changes. Ticket: INFRA-3247

aj: acknowledged. i'll prep the customer impact summary postmortem draft once INFRA-3247 has the remediation ETA.

lee: final: handoff complete. i'm reachable on call for the next hour for any quick clarifications. Leaving doc links again: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-503 | incident: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-8453 | post-incident draft: https://redwood.internal/ops/customer-comm/embeddings-0826-draft.md :white_check_mark:
